services.name: Wreck Fishing
services.desc: The deep waters off the coast of Virginia Beach provide world class offshore fishing opportunities starting in April and lasting through mid-October. How fast the water temps change in spring and fall can have an impact on these dates. Our plan is to be off the dock at 4:30am with a typical cruise to the grounds lasting a bit under 3 hours. Once there we deploy our spread of baits and begin our troll. Early and late season we use heavier tackle in pursuit of “meat fish”. This includes Yellowfin Tuna, Bigeye Tuna, Mahi, and Wahoo. services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Our eco-tours and Sunset Cruises out of Virgina Beach are a great way to experience the variety of wildlife that inhabits the waters just off our shoreline here in Virginia Beach. Whale watching off of Virgina Beach is typically best December through February. The whale most often seen off our coast is the majestic Humpback. These whales often travel alone but can sometimes be seen in pods of two or more. They are usually spotted rolling on the surface, tailing and spouting. If you’re lucky you may catch sight of a humpback breaching clear of the water. Whales are typically found within 10 miles of our inlet and usually within 5 miles of the coastline. blurb: Fly'n Fish offers fishing charters from Virginia Beach targeting species such as Spanish mackerel, bluefish, cobia, red drum, tuna, dolphin (mahi mahi), wahoo, marlin, swordfish, and tilefish. Trips range from shorter near shore half days to full day offshore excursions up to 75+ nautical miles. The 54-foot custom Jim Smith vessel is equipped for safety, speed, and comfort, including air conditioning and a fighting chair for big game fishing.
